STYLE-V2: STYLE-V2: bold clean vector-like cartoon art for a 2D side-scrolling mobile action RPG. Smooth solid dark brown-black outlines, visibly THICK AND UNIFORM, about 2–3 percent of the complete character height, including clear interior contour lines. Large simple solid shapes, FLAT earth colors, 2–3 sharply separated cel-shading tones and one clean highlight. Strong chunky limbs, oversized sturdy fists and broad bare feet, very few LARGE clothing folds. NO fabric grain, NO watercolor/gouache, NO soft painterly blending, NO sketch marks, NO fine hatching, NO tiny noisy details, NO gradients, NO pixel grid. Joint-friendly design: no elaborate folds/straps crossing elbow or knee seams; can later support either whole-pose layers or padded separate 2D skeletal pieces. A simple broad STRAIGHT DOUBLE-EDGED pointed sword, tiny plain crossguard and cord-wrapped grip, outline equally thick as the person. Slash trail is a SOLID OPAQUE WHITE CRESCENT with a thin dark contour, no speckles, blur or glow. A bow curves/bulges toward the enemy at RIGHT; string is behind at LEFT toward the archer. Northern Vietnam, tenth century, undyed cream cloth, earth-brown belt and knee-length pants, tan skin, black hair in a SMALL TOPKNOT. No ornate foreign costume.
AVOID: Avoid: Japanese covert-warrior or samurai clothing, katanas, Chinese imperial dragon robes, Nguyen-dynasty ao dai, conical palm-leaf hats with tassels, winged mandarin hats, multi-tiered curved palace roofs, stone castles with towers, red flags, fantasy monsters, magic glow or glowing energy slashes, modern objects, any text, letters, logos or watermarks.

variants.a: Contour-led version: simple oval face, minimal black hair masses, two flat shading tones, very round solid mitt-like fists, clear rectangular tunic panels.
variants.b: Angular graphic version: clean broad cheek/jaw planes, compact geometric topknot, three crisply bounded color tones, sturdy rounded-block hands and feet, large angular tunic folds.
variants.c: Rounded animation version: friendly determined face, thick rounded contour, two shadow tones plus one small highlight, powerful simple limbs and very restrained curved cloth folds.
